Thriving: The Path to Mental Mastery and Peak Performance

David Reid

Thriving reveals the mental-mastery techniques that transform good into extraordinary. Drawing from his unique journey – from forensic behavioural science to coaching world-class athletes, coaches, artists and business leaders – David Reid unveils his clarity-based framework used by top performers around the globe. In a world where attention is the ultimate currency, this book is not another quick-fix guide. It’s a profound roadmap, blending ancient Eastern wisdom with cutting edge Western science, offering practical tools to help you perform at your peak when it matters most. Whether you’re an athlete, executive or just striving to be your best, Thriving empowers you to overcome mental barriers, find calm under pressure, and unlock your unrealized potential. Packed with actionable exercises, real-world examples and inspiring insights, this book is your guide to mastering your mind and achieving extraordinary results.
